Převezmeš odpovědnost za definici, analýzu a správu systémových požadavků i rozhraní mezi HW a SW komponentami. Navrhneš, připravíš, provedeš a vyhodnotíš integrační, funkční a systémové testy. Navážeš komunikaci s dodavateli avionických systémů, testovací techniky a dalšími technickými partnery. Koho hledáme? Tebe, pokud... ✔ Máš za sebou vysokoškolské vzdělání technického směru. ✔ Pohybuješ se v oblasti systémové integrace, embedded systémů, testování nebo HIL/SIL prostředí. ✔ Orientuješ se v HW/SW rozhraních a dokážeš systematicky řešit technické problémy. ✔Dokážeš navrhovat a realizovat integrační, funkční i systémové testy. ✔ Vyhodnocuješ výsledky zkoušek a efektivně identifikuješ příčiny technických problémů. ✔ Pracuješ samostatně a dovádíš technické úkoly k ověřitelným výsledkům. ✔ Vynikáš analytickým myšlením a dokážeš nacházet souvislosti i v komplexních zadáních. ✔ Patří mezi tvé silné stránky spolehlivost a zodpovědný přístup. ✔ Zakládáš si na preciznosti a všímáš si detailů, které mohou rozhodovat o výsledku. ✔ Komunikativní angličtinu na technické úrovni (min. B2) zvládáš bez problému. Co bude Tvé plus, ale není to podmínkou... ✔ Máš zkušenosti s laboratorní měřicí technikou (osciloskop, logický analyzátor, analyzátor datových sběrnic apod.). ✔ Orientuješ se v komunikačních rozhraních CAN, Ethernet, RS-422/485 nebo UART. ✔ Rozumíš principům a využití rozhraní ARINC 429 nebo MIL-STD-1553. ✔ Umíš pracovat s Pythonem, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulinkem nebo dalšími nástroji pro automatizaci testů. ✔ Pracoval jsi s HIL/SIL prostředími, test rigy nebo nástroji pro simulaci a emulaci zařízení. ✔ Umíš pracovat s nástroji pro správu požadavků a konfigurace, například DOORS, Jama, Jira nebo Git. ✔ Působil jsi v oblasti aerospace, defence, automotive, rail nebo v jiném technicky regulovaném oboru. ✔ Orientuješ se v leteckých standardech, jako jsou ARP4754A, DO-160 nebo DO-178C. ✔ Jsi nadšenec do letectví, elektroniky nebo embedded vývoje. ✔ Vlastní technické projekty nebo modelářství jsou součástí Tvých zájmů. Dostaneš prostor pro odborný rozvoj a realizaci vlastních technických řešení. Zařadíš se do týmu, který stojí za technologiemi budoucnosti českého letectví.

review_candidates.title: SVN2026/039_ Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Associate_ G5_ Port-au-Prince
review_candidates.description: Job Description IOM’s Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) strategy aims to improve the quality and integrity of program delivery, ensure that programs are responsive to the needs of affected populations, and meet donor requirements and standards of accountability. The Monitoring and Evaluation Associate will work as part of the IOM Programme Support Unit, under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) in Haiti and direct supervision of the Monitoring and Evaluation Officer, in close coordination with the Monitoring and Evaluation Officer at the Regional Office (RO). The successful candidate will be supporting the implementation of existing M&E systems, including data collection and analysis, reporting, contributing to Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP), and Knowledge Management (KM) strategies. Responsibilities Participate in field monitoring missions and data collection activities, including observations, surveys, key informant interviews, and focus group discussions, in accordance with the M&E workplan, and under the guidance of the M&E officer. Coordinate and provide day-to-day guidance to field hourly staff engaged in data collection activities, ensuring adherence to established methodologies, tools, protocols, and timelines. Support the field implementation of surveys, assessments, studies, and other monitoring and evaluation activities carried out by third party monitors, under the guidance of the M&E Officer. Regularly update M&E tools, project databases, and tracking systems, ensuring data is complete, accurate, and available for reporting purposes, in coordination with the Programme Teams. Track and monitor progress against project indicators, through the Result Monitoring Framework (RMF), as well as mission- and organizational-level indicator frameworks, including Haiti Mission Indicators, and the IOM Strategic Results Framework (SRF). Conduct data cleaning, validation, and preliminary analysis of data collected through M&E exercises and support the preparation of monitoring reports and related products. Support the preparation of SitReps, factsheets, PowerPoint presentations, result matrices, as well as institutional and donor reports, by compiling monitoring data and related information. Bring to the attention of the M&E Officer any issues regarding the quality of data, reporting timelines, or compliance with M&E requirements and protocols. Support the organization and delivery of training and capacity-building sessions on M&E tools and processes for field project staff and partners. Support the documentation and sharing of lessons learned, good practices, and monitoring and evaluation findings to promote organizational learning and programme improvement. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in international relations, Political or Social Sciences, Business or Public Administration, Law or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of experience or, High School Diploma with five years of relevant professional experience in the above fields. Experience Experience in project monitoring, reporting and evaluation; Experience in supporting data collection exercises and maintaining M&E tools, databases, and tracking systems up to date.; and Experience in organizing consultations and capacity building activities. Skills Reporting, writing preferably in M&E. Excellent computer skills: excellent knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and email/internet software, statistical analysis packages. Knowledge of UN cooperation frameworks and bilateral donor programming requirements; Knowledge in quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis; Ability to consolidate information from multiple sources; High degree of judgment and initiative, ability to work with a high degree of independence within assigned areas. Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills; and, Proven ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with people of diverse cultural and national backgrounds. Languages The official languages of the IOM are English, French, and Spanish. Required Fluency in Creole and French, and working knowledge of English (oral and written). Competencies The incumbent is expected to demonstrate the following values and competencies: VALUES - All IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. CORE COMPETENCIES - Behavioural indicators – Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Other Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. This RFEI closes at 23:59 local time Port-au-Prince, Haiti. No late applications will be accepted.
